falsifiable_hypothesis: The A-side target reliability r_A is a signal-versus-jackknife-noise fraction. The base threefold rule uses r_A^3. If at least two of the three held inner folds independently agree with the sign of the full bounded A gain and r_A>=0.5, signal exceeds noise and directional agreement is a strict whole-patient majority; that target can use full bounded gain without an outer-held outcome.
B_rule: Reproduce global_js_raw_gain_switch exactly for orientation B.
A_rule: Reproduce threefold_confirmed_A_gain through bounded raw A gain gA_raw in [-0.5,0.5], target reliability r_A, global positive-part A reliability, and held-fold local gains gA_local,k=2*rA_k/theta_-k. Base confirmation weight is r_A^3. If gA_raw is nonzero, r_A>=0.5, and at least two of the three local gains have the same sign as gA_raw, set confirmation weight to 1. Otherwise keep r_A^3. If global A reliability is zero, set final A gain to zero. Apply qA=qA_loo_bagged+0.5*weight*gA_raw*theta.
threshold_rationale: r_A>=0.5 is the exact signal-equals-noise boundary of r=s/(s+n); two of three is the minimum strict majority of the fixed three inner whole-patient folds. No threshold or vote-count menu is opened in canonical replay.

task_contract.ab_rule: average separately costed A/B losses; never average predictions
